items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father, Louis Andrew Donaldson, Sr.

ctx.x: I’m Ted Panken. It’s June 20, 2012, and it’s day one of an interview with Lou Donaldson for the Smithsonian Institution Oral History Jazz Project. I’d like to start by putting on the record, Mr. Donaldson, your full name and your parents’ names, your mother and father.
Yeah. Louis Andrew Donaldson, Jr. My father, Louis Andrew Donaldson, Sr. My mother was Lucy Wallace Donaldson.
You grew up in Badin, North Carolina?
